lines: I shout out a love that won't fall silent
Holding everything, I'm here
The light is there
Bridging the longing I won't give up
I'll live to the far edge of hope
Linking dreams with you
A new era, someday
We'll bring it into being with our own hands
Even your gentle voice can surely change the world
No one, all alone,
can ever rise to their feet
So we reach out our hands to each other
Toward a tomorrow beyond our limits
I shout out a love that won't fall silent
We clash, and we come to understand
We'll make the light ourselves
Bridging the longing that won't give up
I'll live to the far edge of hope
Linking dreams with you
Whenever, fearing my own mistakes,
I end up blaming someone
I realize the one I truly need to look at is myself
The words you changed me with set my heart in motion
An innovation yet unseen—
I seek it in this racing heart
The wind of surging longing
flickered hot behind my eyelids
You don't look back
Setting out from those shining days
You step forward toward the far edge of hope
Linking dreams with you
I don't want to lose to sorrow
I want to overcome anger
I want to face my wavering weakness and get past it
So I say this to you:
Even if someone laughs at us
I'll keep protecting the voice of living together
I shout out a love that won't fall silent
Holding everything, I'm here
The light is there
Bridging the longing I won't give up
I'll live to the far edge of hope
Linking dreams with you
With you
